_comment: Vehicle atlas registry — Phase 9 complete. All 5 V1 vehicle types assigned to 4x4 diffuse atlas (upload_path srgb), 8x8 normal atlas (upload_path linear), and 16x16 sprite atlas (upload_path linear, mip_levels=1). Placeholder DDS files generated by tools/generate_dds_stubs.py. See architecture/asset-standards/building-atlas-layout.md.

normal_atlas._comment_normal_atlas: same row/col assignments as diffuse but 8x8 grid; U=[C/8,(C+1)/8], V=[R/8,(R+1)/8]

sprite_atlas._comment: Vehicle sprite atlas encodes synthetic palette-swatch roof colors (not photographic diffuse). LINEAR UPLOAD EXCEPTION: uploaded via linear pool (IVideoDriver::getTexture()), not raw GL sRGB path.

assignments.comment: V1 hatchback — diffuse cell (0,1); U=[0.25,0.50], V=[0.00,0.25]
V1 standard bus — diffuse cell (1,0); U=[0.00,0.25], V=[0.25,0.50]
V1 cargo truck — diffuse cell (1,1); U=[0.25,0.50], V=[0.25,0.50]

confirmed: V-flip UV convention is correctly documented in the atlas layout spec (OpenGL convention: V=0 at bottom-left, V increases upward; row 0 is the BOTTOM row; artists must apply V_opengl = 1 - V_blender before mapping UV islands to atlas cells in Blender)
Atlas cell boundary UV formulas are correct: diffuse 4x4 grid U=[C/4,(C+1)/4] V=[R/4,(R+1)/4]; normal 8x8 grid U=[C/8,(C+1)/8] V=[R/8,(R+1)/8]
All five V1 vehicle type assignments (car_sedan row0/col0, car_hatchback row0/col1, car_suv row0/col2, bus_standard row1/col0, truck_cargo row1/col1) are in correct cell positions

All 5 V1 vehicle DDS placeholder files generated: vehicles_diffuse_atlas_d.dds (2048x2048 DXT1, 4 mip levels, sRGB upload), vehicles_normal_atlas_n.dds (2048x2048 DXT5 DXT5nm, 4 mip levels, linear upload), vehicles_sprite_atlas_d.dds (256x256 DXT5, 1 mip level, GL_TEXTURE_MAX_LEVEL=0, linear upload — synthetic palette-swatch exception)

Sprite atlas linear upload exception confirmed: vehicles_sprite_atlas_d.dds carries suffix _d.dds but is uploaded via IVideoDriver::getTexture() (linear pool), not the raw-GL sRGB path, per spec exception for synthetic roof-colour swatches

All 5 V1 vehicle assignments verified correct: car_sedan(row=0,col=0), car_hatchback(row=0,col=1), car_suv(row=0,col=2), bus_standard(row=1,col=0), truck_cargo(row=1,col=1); cells 3–15 of diffuse atlas reserved for post-V1 vehicles
Normal atlas grid confirmed 8x8 (256x256 px per cell) distinct from diffuse atlas 4x4 (512x512 px per cell); UV formulas differ accordingly
